top_issues: Legend uses the same green for On-chain, Reserve and Secured, so the balance bar cannot show that split — the absolute-scale promise breaks on the home bar.
RECENT rows mix amounts and statuses (Swap closed has no figure) and raw 04:41:03 clock times read as test, not product.
'Show 1 empty' and 'Add money / Move' are low-contrast secondary links that bury the on-ramp Maya needs.
fixes: Give each money-state its own hue (on-chain teal, reserve green, collateral amber) and segment the home bar accordingly.
Render timestamps as relative human dates and require every activity row to carry an amount or an explicit '—'.
Promote 'Add money' to a primary action next to Pay/Receive/Swap.

top_issues: Fee shown as 0.000050 USDC and route fee as '0.0000025 of 0.0000050 total' — overprecise decimals that look like a bug and scare a $25 payer.
Recipient field leads with a 40-char hex address; the friendly H2 name is easy to miss.
'Instant  Change' juxtaposition is ambiguous — Change reads as editing the amount, not the route.
fixes: Format sub-cent fees as '<$0.01' or '0.00005' with a single significant figure and a tooltip for the raw value.
Show the resolved name large and collapse the hex into a small copyable line.
Rename the link to 'Choose route' and move it under the Route panel.

top_issues: Proof hash is truncated with no visible copy affordance, so the 'forwardable proof' promise needs a guess.
'in 8 s' and 'Settled 04:41:11' use machine clock format that won't age well in a forwarded PDF.
Four equal-weight buttons (Copy/Download/Print/Done) dilute the primary 'Done' action.
fixes: Add a copy icon on the proof hash and frame number.
Use human date + time and 'settled in 8 seconds'.
Demote Download/Print to a secondary row so Done is the lone primary.

top_issues: '25.50 capacity via H1' is channel jargon placed where a first-timer expects 'your address'.
The copyable Entity ID sits in a quiet right rail while the QR dominates — the actual identifier is hard to grab.
QR is small for a 'show at checkout' use case; no tap-to-enlarge.
fixes: Label the rail 'Your wallet address' with the hex and a copy button; move capacity into an expandable 'incoming room' note.
Increase QR size and add a fullscreen toggle.
Default the amount field to blank with a clear 'any amount' hint.

top_issues: 'You receive 0.039992' is rendered in placeholder gray, underselling the result the user is deciding on.
Hub fee 'up to 0.0000 WETH' displays a meaningless zero — looks broken.
bps, lot rounding and collateral tariff stack as dense prose below the CTA, overwhelming the swap decision.
fixes: Render the receive amount at full weight and color it like the pay field.
Suppress zero fees or show '<0.0001'.
Collapse tariff/lot-rounding into one 'Fee & settlement details' disclosure.

top_issues: A cross-network swap forces the user to configure a collateral slider, credit-limit buffer and a new bilateral account before the disabled CTA unlocks — far too much for Fatima's transfer.
The tooltip overlaps the slider handle and the 'Prepare to receive' card, hiding the value being set.
Red 'Prepare incoming capacity before swapping' is the only clear signal, but the fix path is buried in the slider above it.
fixes: Replace the inline collateral machinery with a one-tap 'Prepare receiving account' wizard that returns to the swap.
Anchor tooltips away from interactive controls and never over a slider.
Make the disabled CTA itself the link to the preparation step.

top_issues: Left card says 'Collateral 60.00' while the right 'THIS ACCOUNT' panel says 'Covered by collateral $0.00' and 'They owe you uncovered $90.00' — three numbers that cannot all be true, destroying trust.
The +90 bar's green segment does not match the 60 collateral figure, so the absolute-scale bar lies.
'In flight' legend color (violet hatch) is never used on the bars, leaving an orphan key.
fixes: Define one source of truth: covered = min(collateral, owed); reconcile 60 vs 0 vs 90 and color the bar from the same values.
Remove legend entries that never appear on this screen.
Add a one-line formula note under 'Covered by collateral'.

top_issues: 'Swap closed' row carries no amount, breaking the ledger's completeness for an accountant.
Detail panel's 'Proof' hash is truncated with no copy button, weakening the exportable-evidence story.
Time column uses 04:41:11 only; no day/date grouping beyond 'TODAY'.
fixes: Show net fill amount and fee on swap rows.
Add copy affordances on every hex in the detail panel.
Group by date with human timestamps.

top_issues: Near-identical to 07 with no added state, so the detail panel's value (frames, proof) is shown but not actionable — no 'open frame' or 'verify on chain' link.
'2 committed entries' is abstract; the user can't see what they are.
Selected-row highlight is too subtle against the list.
fixes: Make Frame #61 and Proof clickable to a frame inspector.
List the two committed entries inline.
Strengthen the selected row's background and left accent.

top_issues: 'Reveal recovery phrase' and 'Forget vault' sit on the same flat row with no visible guardrail, risky for a self-custodial product.
Bar-scale preview bars for $10,000/$100,000 run to the card edge and fade, but the fade rule isn't labeled on the bar itself.
DESIGN preset section is dense and low-contrast ('presets · yours to change').
fixes: Require confirmation / biometric on reveal and forget, and visually separate destructive actions.
Annotate the fading bar with 'clipped at card width'.
Raise contrast on the presets caption.

top_issues: TO-side 'Account 150.00' presents a destination capacity as if it were a balance, confusing source vs target.
'WHAT HAPPENS' shows a single non-selectable radio, reading as a broken control.
No fee or settlement-time summary for a reserve→account move.
fixes: On TO cards show 'can hold up to' rather than a balance figure.
Render the outcome as plain text, not a radio, when there is one option.
Add a one-line effect summary (on-chain post, instant use).

top_issues: The lower half of the page is empty, so the screen feels unfinished despite carrying the key 'where your money stands' summary.
'Yours whatever a hub does' is awkward phrasing for the headline safety number.
Five entry cards and the summary don't establish a clear primary next step.
fixes: Add an attention/insights strip or recent account deltas to fill the void.
Rename to 'Safe regardless of hubs'.
Mark one card (Sovereignty) as the default deep-dive.

top_issues: Faucet panel demands collateral-slider and credit-limit configuration to claim test money, with raw floats like 25.500023 / 74.499977 / 81.949975 — unreadable and absurd friction.
'Receive USDC from H1' is disabled with the enable path hidden inside the same overloaded card.
Three on-chain balances all read 0.00 with 'Depository may pull 0.00' — an empty state that looks like a fault.
fixes: Round all displayed values to 2 significant decimals and hide the prepare-account block behind a single 'Prepare' button.
Show an explicit empty-state illustration when on-chain is zero.
Tie the disabled CTA's tooltip to the exact missing step.

top_issues: H1 POOL shows Available/Borrowed/Active principal all 0.00 with no explanation, reading as broken rather than empty.
Borrow tab is present but unexplored in the set, so the lend/borrow symmetry is unproven.
Disabled 'Offer to the pool' gives no reason (amount is 0.00).
fixes: Add a 'pool not yet funded' empty state with a hint.
Provide a borrow screenshot/state.
Label the disabled CTA with 'enter an amount'.

top_issues: For a DAO treasurer wanting multisig, the page only describes that a board 'can grow' — there is no Add signer / Change threshold control, blocking the task.
Overwhelming empty lower canvas makes the screen look stubbed.
Jargon 'lazy entity', 'EntityProvider' is unexplained inline.
fixes: Add an explicit 'Add signer' and 'Set threshold' action with quorum presets (2-of-3, 3-of-5).
Fill the page with current board members and pending rotations.
Gloss lazy entity / EntityProvider on first use.

top_issues: The PER COUNTERPARTY card's text is clipped at the right edge ('...→ Manage → Dispute' cut off), hiding the dispute path this screen exists to give.
'Collateral behind what you are owed $0.00' repeats the 06 contradiction against the 60 figure.
'in this page · 0x1e0b60...0faf' runtime label is cryptic.
fixes: Constrain the right card width and wrap the action trail; make 'Dispute' a real button.
Reconcile collateral across all screens from one value.
Rename to 'Runtime (this device)' with a copyable id.

top_issues: Table header 'LINES OUT·IN' is truncated and the book bars bleed past the panel edge.
SECURED column shows '—' for every hub row while 06 claimed 60 collateral — the dense view contradicts the detail view.
Reserve·on-chain row carries PROMISED $90.00 in violet, but promised is hub credit, not on-chain reserve — a category error in the headline table.
fixes: Widen the header cell and clip book bars inside their card.
Source SECURED from the same collateral value as 06.
Move the $90 promised onto the H1 row only; reserve row should show on-chain secured.

top_issues: Several rows (Home, Desk, Activity, Ownership) have no right-hand hint while others do, leaving the column ragged.
No visible keyboard selection indicator beyond the single highlighted row.
Background dim is heavy, obscuring the desk the palette is jumping from.
fixes: Give every row a one-word hint or none at all.
Show arrow-key focus ring and ⏎ affordance.
Reduce scrim opacity to keep context.

overall.verdict: A genuinely distinctive, premium wallet whose absolute-scale bars, before/after account math and provable-evidence surfaces set it apart from every crypto UI on the market. It is held back from shipping-grade by a small set of data-integrity bugs — collateral shown as 60 in one place and 0 in another, overprecise float dumps, clipped text and empty pool states — plus two screens (cross-swap, faucet) that bury a simple task under credit-limit sliders.
priority_fixes: Reconcile collateral/covered/owed across 06, 15 and 16 from a single derived value so the absolute-scale bars and the numbers tell one truth.
Clamp every monetary display to 2–4 significant decimals; never render 0.0000, 25.500023 or 74.499977.
Collapse the cross-swap and faucet 'prepare account' collateral slider + credit-limit buffer into a one-tap wizard that returns to the action.
Fix clipped/truncated text: sovereignty counterparty card, desk 'LINES OUT·IN' header, book bars bleeding past the panel.
Humanize timestamps and design real empty states (zero pool, 'Swap closed' amount, all-zero on-chain balances).
